description: Buried and unawakened, most of the resonance vein network is dark; only the thinnest tracery of pale cyan threads remains visible beneath the hull's skin, a slow heartbeat barely perceptible against the dimmed pearl surface.

reference_images.label: Valkyrie-1 in the dormant state
reference_images.instruction: match this hull state: near-black pearl hull, veins almost dark, faint pale-cyan tracery; this is concept art: take the glow color and intensity relationship only, rendered photographically and mostly in shadow
